caption: Pearson correlations between each Cass Freight signal lagged L months and the SPY 1-month forward return. Cells are small at nearly every lead and the few starred ones are scattered and flip sign across transforms — the signature of a coincident series with no stable predictive lead. The winner's own signal (the contraction flag) is weak across the whole row, peaking only at L9 — which is why the deployed L9 lead is best read as a likely search artifact (issue #28).
narrative_alignment_note: Honest near-null lead view; winner signal 'contraction' peaks at L9 but weakly.
